content.text: What Time Does Invincible Season 4 Come Out on Prime Video?Invincible season 4 is set to premiere on Prime Video on March 18, 2026. The premiere will drop at 12:00 a.m. Pt / 3:00 a.m. Et, meaning West Coast fans can start watching the show right at midnight, while East Coast viewers will have to set a late-night alarm to binge the show (via Games Radar).Now, whether you’re watching for the emotional arcs, shocking twists, or intense action, you might want to clear your schedule for this one!
